title: Chungking Actively Reviving Anti-Japanese Education In Shanghai

November 19, 1939.

TAIRIKU SHIMPO

CHUNGKING ACTIVELY REVIVING ANTI-JAPANESE
EDUCATION IN SHANGHAI

Between August and October
the Chungking Government planned terrorist activi'iss
among educational circles in Shanghai in order to
undermine the peaceful educationists, but the educational
activities of Tao She Sun and Chow Fu Hai, followers
of Wang Ching Wei, were effective in putting a stop
to the acts of terrorism in the educational circle.
It is reported that last
summer Huang Wen Yuen and Chiang Chien Bah, chief of
the Educational Bureau of the former National City
Government, were dispatched to Shanghai by the Chungking
Government to deal with educational affairs in Shanghai.
There are 7 schools of college
grade, 20 middle schools and many primary schools in
Shanghai, which are managed by the Chungking Government
which remits about $3,500,000 a year for the management
of such schools. The headquarters of the Chungking
Government's educational activities is reported to be
located in Room No. 28, House No. 21, lane 126 Szechuen
Road, International Settlement.

（批：Agrees. File attached.）

1939年11月19日。

《大陆新报》

重庆方面在上海积极恢复反日教育

八月至十月间，重庆政府在教育界策划恐怖活动，旨在破坏主张和平的教育工作者，但汪精卫的追随者陶锡孙（音译）和周佛海的教育活动有效地制止了教育界的恐怖行为。据报，去年夏天，前上海特别市政府教育局局长黄文元（音译）和蒋建白（音译）被重庆政府派往上海处理上海的教育事务。上海有7所大专院校、20所中学和许多小学由重庆政府管理，该政府每年汇拨约350万美元用于管理这些学校。据报，重庆政府教育活动的总部设在公共租界四川路126弄21号28室。

（批：同意。附件存档。）
（签名）
11月22日

（批：C）
（批：Pst. 1月24日）

SHANGHAI MUNICIPAL POLICE.    File No. ________
S. 1, Special Branch ________
REPORT
Date October 3, 1939.

Subject Woosung Mercantile Navigation College Alumni Association -
Executive interviewed.

Made by ________ and ________ Forwarded by D.I. Crawford

In connection with the registration of ex-students
of the defunct Woosung Mercantile Navigation College now
undertaken by the Woosung Mercantile Navigation College,
Room 28, 2nd floor, Lane 156, House 21, Szechuen Road,
on behalf of the Chungking Mercantile Navigation College,
Woo Ts-yien (吳志賢), Chairman of the alumni
association, was interviewed at headquarters at 11 a.m.
October 3. It was brought to his notice the reports
appearing in the Sin Shun Pao dated September 30 alleging
that the National Government was behind this Office which
was once the Ministry of Education and was endeavouring
to induce youths to leave for Chungking, and such a
construction might cause embarrassment. Mr. Woo stated
that he realised that his efforts had caused the people
interested to take advantage of it and has therefore
discontinued the registration from October 2nd. The
office is still being used as an office for the alumni
association.

（印：SPECIAL BRANCH）

C. Crawford
D. I.

D. C. (Special Branch).

S. 1, 特别处 ________
报告
日期：1939年10月3日。

主题：吴淞商船专科学校校友会——约谈负责人。

由 ________ 和 ________ 制作，由督察长克劳福德转呈

关于现已停办的吴淞商船专科学校前学生的登记工作，目前由位于四川路21号156弄2楼28室的吴淞商船专科学校代表重庆商船专科学校进行办理。10月3日上午11时，在校本部约谈了校友会主席吴志贤。向他指出了9月30日《新闻报》上刊登的报道，该报道声称国民政府在该办事处背后支持，该办事处曾是教育部，并正试图诱导青年前往重庆，这种解读可能会引起尴尬。吴先生表示，他意识到自己的努力已被相关人士利用，因此已于10月2日停止登记。该办公室仍作为校友会办公室使用。

（印章：特别处）

C. 克劳福德
督察长

副督察长（特别处）。

G. 90M-1-39

SHANGHAI MUNICIPAL POLICE.    File No. ____
    D.I., Special Branch A.S.D.O.X.
REPORT
Date October 3, 1939.
Subject Allegation that the National Government has established
an office in the Settlement to advise local youths
to pursue their studies at Chungking, etc.
Made by. D.S.I. Kao Yen-ken Forwarded by. C. [Signature]

With reference to the attached translation of an
article appearing in the Sin Shun Pao dated September 30
on the subject of "Cultural Circles in Foreign Settle-
ments of Shanghai" alleging that the Chungking Government
has established in Room 28, 2nd floor, Lane 126, House
21, Szechuen Road, a Shanghai office of the Ministry of
Education for the purpose of advising Chinese youths
to pursue their studies either at Chungking, Kunming
or Chengtu, enquiries at the said address show that no
office of the Ministry of Education exists there.
It is the office of the Woosung Mercantile Navigation
College Alumni Association. Woo Is-yien (吳志賢),
an engineer of the Tung Wei (通惠) Iron Works, Lane 5,
Rue de Moulin, is in charge of the Society.
At the request of Soong Chien-shiung (宋建勳),
an ex-teacher of the now defunct Woosung Mercantile
Navigation College, at present working in the Chungking
Mercantile Navigation College, Chungking, (sponsored by
the National Government), the Alumni Association under-
takes the registration of those ex-students of the
defunct Woosung Mercantile Navigation College who wish
to continue their studies in the new Chungking
Mercantile Navigation College. The registration start-
ed on September 29. Up to the present, eight ex-students
have enlisted with the association.

Kao Yen-ken
D. S. I.

D. C. (Special Branch).

（左侧手写批注：）
S.A.
Suggest he be told
to cease his activities
in case of complication.
[Signature/Initials]

上海公共租界工部局警务处。档案号 ____
    副督察长，特别处 A.S.D.O.X.
报告
日期：1939年10月3日。
主题：关于国民政府在租界设立办事处以建议本地青年赴重庆求学等的指控。
制作人：高级副督察长高延肯（音译） 转呈人：C. [签名]

关于附上的9月30日《新闻报》文章的译文，主题为“上海外国租界的文化界”，指控重庆政府在四川路21号126弄2楼28室设立了教育部上海办事处，目的是建议中国青年前往重庆、昆明或成都求学。经在上述地址查询，显示那里并无教育部办事处。那是吴淞商船专科学校校友会的办公室。通惠铁厂（位于穆勒路5弄）工程师吴志贤负责该会事务。
应现已停办的吴淞商船专科学校前教师、目前在重庆商船专科学校（由国民政府资助）工作的宋建勋的请求，校友会负责登记那些希望在新的重庆商船专科学校继续学习的原吴淞商船专科学校学生。登记工作于9月29日开始。截至目前，已有八名前学生在该会登记。

高延肯
高级副督察长

副督察长（特别处）。

（左侧手写批注：）
S.A.
建议告知他停止活动，以免发生复杂情况。
[签名/首字母缩写]

page_data.en:
Sin Shun Pao (Japanese-owned Chinese language newspaper) :
30.9.39 (AM) CULTURAL CIRCLES IN FOREIGN SETTLEMENTS OF SHANGHAI

As the cultural and educational circles in the
Foreign Settlements of Shanghai are abandoning the
Chungking Government and are gradually adopting a policy
of awaiting the establishment of a new Central Government
by the Wang Ching-wei clique, the Ministry of Education of
the Chungking Government has been doing its utmost to
retain its influence over these circles. However, its
efforts have ended in failure as may be proved by the
following cases:-
Recently the Chungking Government established
in Room 28, second floor, of House 21 Lane 126 Szechuen
Road, a Shanghai Office of the Ministry of Education to
advise Chinese youths in the Foreign Settlements of Shanghai
to pursue their studies either at Chungking or Kunming or
Chengtu. Nevertheless, no youths have applied for
registration. This is sufficient proof that the Chungking
Government is in difficulties and that the situation to-day
is vastly different from that of the days when strong
anti-Japanese movements were started by students.

page_data.zh:
《新闻报》（日资中文报纸）：
1939年9月30日（上午版） 上海外国租界的文化界

随着上海外国租界的文化教育界放弃重庆政府，并逐渐采取等待汪精卫集团建立新中央政府的政策，重庆政府教育部一直竭尽全力保持对这些界别的影响力。然而，其努力最终以失败告终，以下案例可资证明：
最近，重庆政府在四川路126弄21号2楼28室设立了教育部上海办事处，以建议上海外国租界的中国青年前往重庆、昆明或成都求学。然而，没有青年申请登记。这充分证明重庆政府处境困难，且今日的局势与学生发起强烈反日运动时期的情况大不相同。
